$Comment: The spot the Yeti rises from (Christmas_Yeti). It stands in the Yeti Cave's prefab as a marker entity in front of his den, beside the fight's own entity, so every fresh copy of the cave brings a fresh one. ManualTrigger means it never spawns the Yeti on its own: only the fight's script raises him, once players come into the cave, and only while his last spawn is gone. RealtimeRespawn and RealtimeRespawnTime are the respawn form every marker must write; a marker that only fires on request never reads them. DeactivationDistance and DeactivationTime are wide so the Yeti is never packed back into the marker mid-fight.
